Description



**PLEASE ENSURE YOU WEAR PLASTIC-STUDDED FOOTWEAR ONLY, DO NOT USE METAL STUDE, BLADES, DIMPLED OR FLAT SHOES.**

Dockland Settlements Charity recently had the 5 a-side astroturf pitch re-laid with a shockpad and 50mm “Tiger Turf” – the best astroturf on the market. The pitch is a large 5-a-side pitch (19m x 30m) with Futsal style goals and line markings allowing teams the option of either playing within the lines or off the boards. It also has a roof-net so no lost balls or interruptions in play. All profits from pitch hire go towards charitable causes.
The Dockland Settlements Community Centre has changing rooms, showers, lockers, floodlights, a café, free car parking on the road, a dance studio and large indoor sports hall.
The closest stations are Canada Water and Surrey Quays – just a short walk from either or a quick bus - for more details on how to access the facility please get in touch.
